name: megalens
description: Independent multi-company code review for Codex CLI and the Codex desktop app. One command starts the review, waits up to 20 minutes, and shows findings inline.

interface.shortDescription: Independent code review right inside Codex
interface.longDescription: Start a MegaLens code review with one command ($megalens-review, $megalens:megalens-review, or /prompts:megalens-review). Waits up to 20 minutes and shows findings inline using the same runner order as MegaLens for Claude Code.
